body.x: Kwangwoon University, participated ‘2017 Korea Electronics Show(KES)’ held at COEX in Samseong-dong from October 17th (Tue) to 20th (Fri) and introduced Plasma Medical Devices and Hologram Research Achievements.

The professor Choi Eun-Ha of Kwangwoon University said, “I have come from Plasma Bio-Science Research Center” and added, “We pan to aim development and research activity for the fundamental of Plasma interaction in Human’s disease”. Also, “KES is introducing Plasma related medical devices related to cancer, Alzheimer, and Parkinson’s disease, and informed “The Plasma related medical devices is being exported to various countries such as India, Bolivia, Dubai and Europe”.

The professor Hwang Yong-Seok of Kangwoon University said, “I have come from Holodigital Research Media Center” and added, “We are researching and developing about the original technology of Hologram human media, and we also do research & development for science and technology’s future vision, which can be seen in Hollywood SF movies such as Star Wars and Iron man. He also informed, “We have exhibited 3 types of Prototype that has high-resolution and 3D effect, and currently we are doing industrial collaboration with many companies”.

Meanwhile, KES 2017, hosted by Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy and sponsored by KEA (Korea Electronics Association), is an international show where lots of potential buyers, governments, group officials participate, providing a good place to experience world first products like mobile phone, semiconductor, display, and next generation convergence solutions like industrial convergence, IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education and e health.
